UPDATE backup SET status = $2, consistent = $3, files = $4, directories = $5,
                               bytes = $6, chunks_new = $7, bytes_new = $8, stored_bytes = $9,
                               files_unchanged = $10, skipped = $11, error = $12,
                               finished_at = $13
              WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'pending'
